name: @structura/video
description: Explainer videos rendered with Remotion (React to MP4).

scripts.thumbs: remotion still src/index.ts UrlShortener ../web/public/videos/url-shortener.jpg --frame=1500 --scale=0.5 --image-format=jpeg && remotion still src/index.ts Rbac ../web/public/videos/rbac.jpg --frame=2300 --scale=0.5 --image-format=jpeg && remotion still src/index.ts UberSurge ../web/public/videos/uber-surge.jpg --frame=450 --scale=0.5 --image-format=jpeg && remotion still src/index.ts DockerVsVm ../web/public/videos/docker-vs-vm.jpg --frame=700 --scale=0.5 --image-format=jpeg && remotion still src/index.ts IdempotentPayments ../web/public/videos/payment-idempotency.jpg --frame=575 --scale=0.5 --image-format=jpeg
scripts.render: npm run render:docker && npm run render:uber && npm run render:url && npm run render:rbac && npm run render:payments
